records.name: Resend Inboxes
records.tagline: Create shared inboxes, connect your agents, build workflows
records.description: The best way to reach humans instead of spam folders. Deliver transactional and marketing emails at scale.

records.name: heal.dev
records.tagline: Find bugs and vulnerabilities code review misses
records.description: Code review catches what’s wrong in a diff. Heal catches what breaks when the app runs. Heal learns how to run your application, builds a production-like sandbox with external services stubbed, then hunts for bugs, performance regressions, and runtime vulnerabilities users would hit. It reproduces every defect before reporting it, so you get real bugs to fix, not a backlog of AI-generated suspicions.

records.name: Dadan
records.tagline: One AI video workspace for recordings, meetings and guides
records.description: Most teams juggle one tool for async video, another for meeting notes, and a third for how-to docs. Dadan brings all three together, then goes further: make any video interactive with polls, CTAs, and lead forms that turn viewers into signups. Built for sales, marketing, and customer success teams creating demos, onboarding, and training content. Product Hunt offer: 3 months free on PRO with code PRODUCTHUNT

records.name: Mistral Voxtral 3
records.tagline: Mistral’s speech models for transcription, TTS and agents
records.description: Voxtral 3 is Mistral’s new family of speech-to-text and text-to-speech models, plus a voice agent SDK built on LiveKit. Transcription covers 50+ languages with diarization and context biasing, and realtime transcription runs under 500ms. TTS adapts emotion and pacing, with voice cloning from 30+ minutes of audio. Batch transcription starts at $0.0035 per minute, and the models are available through Mistral’s API.

records.name: Claude Duet
records.tagline: Proactive agent that understands what needs your attention
records.description: Claude Duet is a helpful, proactive agent you hand off work to through messages. Tell it what you need and it works on its own computer in the cloud, using apps you connect. It messages you when it is done or needs a decision from you. While it’s always on, it uses good judgment when it reaches out and knows what can wait.

records.name: Claire Mail
records.tagline: Email, calendar and reminders, in one fast app
records.description: Claire brings Gmail, Google Calendar and Apple Reminders together for Mac and iPhone, with AI that triages your inbox, writes your daily brief and preps your meetings.

records.name: Tetriz Engg Intelligence + Connectors
records.tagline: Connect coding sessions to PRs, issues, quality, and ROI
records.description: Open-source engineering intelligence across GitHub, Jira, and 7 more tools. Understand work complexity, spot likely sources of bugs, and compare AI-assisted work with the rest. Connect coding sessions to delivery and measure ROI with quality factored in.

records.name: DeepCell
records.tagline: Your deadline survival kit for office work
records.description: Deepcell can help you with deadline tasks that require narrations, calculation and presentation at the same time, such as modeling, sales review, budget forecast and monthly report. DeepCell (both web app and agent plug-in) can create ready-to-use docs, spreadsheets, and slides—with sources and cheat sheets to help you explain. Furthermore, every edit can update related parts. The product is built on a newly designed document format (.deepcell), which is especially designed for system two tasks.

records.name: Voxelo 3.0
records.tagline: Phone video to photoreal 3D & JSON-LD in an hour
records.description: Your products now have two shoppers: people and AI agents. Voxelo turns a three-minute phone video into a photoreal 3D twin in around an hour, and both can read it: interactive 3D, place-in-space AR with nothing to install, AI product and lifestyle imagery, and 2-3x the product attributes of a typical product page, published as JSON-LD. Already have splats? Host 100 free with viewer, AR links, editor and API. New in 3.0: API, analytics, publish to SuperSplat. Captured, not generated.

records.name: Teclo
records.tagline: Mechanical keyboard sounds and a keycap pet for your Mac
records.description: Teclo sits in your Mac menu bar and plays a mechanical keyboard sound for every key you press, in any app. A keycap pet reacts as you type and powers up when you keep the pace. 10 sound packs. USD 4.99 once, for life, with a 7-day free trial.

records.name: Doneas
records.tagline: A daily accountability call with other entrepreneurs.
records.description: Doneas helps solo builders stay focused, accountable, and productive. Plan your week every Monday, join a 15-minute daily accountability call with five other builders, and track everything you ship on your public progress page. Plan less. Focus better. Ship more.

records.name: Playad
records.tagline: Hire your AI Marketing Team
records.description: Playad is your AI marketing team. Paid ads on autopilot: it learns your brand, makes the ads, and gets smarter every time. From one chat, research competitors, create image and video ads, launch campaigns, and analyze performance. Schedule recurring checks, creative refreshes, and reports. Playad remembers your brand, experiments, and results to inform what to try next. You stay in control through review and approval. Stop creating. Start deciding.

records.name: Notif
records.tagline: AI for your Apple Reminders
records.description: Notif turns your Apple Reminders into actions. Write a note the way you normally would, and Notif adds two things: an Insight (a useful fact or tip for that note) and an Action Button for the next step, like opening a map, a store, a booking page, or the app you already use. Every note is a real Apple Reminder, so it syncs across your devices and works with Siri and widgets. Private notes are encrypted on your iPhone and open with Face ID. Free, no account needed. Pro unlocks unlimited Insights.

records.name: Concierge by Juniors AI
records.tagline: Omni-channel AI-first customer support (6 months free)
records.description: Juniors AI Concierge is AI-powered customer support for modern teams. Unify WhatsApp, Instagram, email and in-app chat in one workspace, automate repetitive requests with human handover, ask questions about your data in plain English, and track AI and human agent performance. Built on a Bring Your Own Infrastructure model: connect your database, Redis and AI provider keys, and we handle the AI orchestration. Smarter support, full control.

records.name: Bits
records.tagline: An open-source personal agent that gets you things done
records.description: Bits is a personal agent that runs on your own machine and never sleeps. A small background daemon does the work: routines wake it on a schedule, and tasks keep going when the app is closed. Every step is saved, so a crash just resumes. Memory lives in plain Markdown files you can read and edit. Risky actions pass the Sentinel, a reviewer that only trusts your own words. It answers with live cards and mini-apps, talks by voice, opens with ⌥Space, and works with any model, including local ones.

records.name: Loom Record for agents
records.tagline: Hit record and hand off to AI, now in the new Loom app
records.description: Record your screen, a meeting, yourself and now…record for agents. No more typing out prompts to explain what's on your screen to agents. Capture video, audio, and on-screen actions, turning everyday walkthroughs into agent-ready prompts any AI tool can act on. Built natively into the reimagined, faster Loom for Mac app with precision area recording, new cam shapes, filters, backgrounds, and 4K capture by default. Give your AI agents the full picture. Also available in the Chrome extension.

records.name: Agentic CleanSlop
records.tagline: Authenticate, scan and fix your app from your agent
records.description: Paste one line into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Bot or Muse. Your agent authenticates you with Stripe Link (no sign-up, no password), scans your vibe-coded TypeScript/Node.js app for what breaks with real users, then fixes it. More scans? Approve in Link.

records.name: Sponkly
records.tagline: Live voice translation for chats, calls, meetings & YouTube
records.description: Sponkly lets everyone speak their own language. Chat, call or meet with anyone: each person writes, speaks and hears in their language, with live subtitles and a natural translated voice, in 32 languages. The Chrome extension does the same for YouTube, online courses, webinars and Google Meet, Teams and Zoom on the web. Chats are end-to-end encrypted. Free to start on the web, Android and Chrome; iPhone coming soon.

records.name: ElevenLabs Realtime Translation
records.tagline: Turn live speech into translated audio as people talk
records.description: Eleven Realtime Translation is a streaming voice layer for telecom operators, contact centers and live events. Each person speaks their own language and hears the other in theirs, across 90+ languages. Unlike caption-only tools or stitched STT, LLM and TTS pipelines, it goes from live speech to expressive translated audio over one WebSocket, keeps one consistent voice (library or your own clone), streams captions and transcripts, and lets you tune speed vs accuracy per use case.

records.name: Causo
records.tagline: Find leads beyond database filters with AI research & MCP
records.description: Your ideal customers don't always fit into database filters. Describe what you're looking for in plain English, and Causo investigates public sources to find companies worth pursuing, with evidence behind each match. Dig deeper in Causo's chat or run the same research in ChatGPT and Claude through MCP. Once you know who fits and why, Causo helps find decision-makers, verify their emails, and write outreach grounded in that research. Better GTM intelligence. Less slop.

records.name: Archivist
records.tagline: From messy filenames to shareable collections
records.description: New since our first launch: drop a folder and every image and video gets a name you'd actually search for, in your naming convention – Web, Social, Product, Documentation, AI, or your own built from blocks like date, product and content. Keep files in collections, one per client: Archivist suggests the right one, and collections can fill themselves. Share a collection as one clean link. Try 5 files free, no signup. Mac app coming soon.

records.name: CutBay
records.tagline: AI Video Agent: Turn Anything into Videos via Chat
records.description: CutBay is an AI video agent that turns anything into videos via chat. Instead of manually editing timelines, users simply describe what they want, and CutBay handles planning, scripting, visuals, voiceovers, subtitles, and editing. It creates videos from prompts, URLs, docs, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, and media assets, then refines them through natural conversation. Professional video creation, as easy as having a conversation.

records.name: Kalender Sync
records.tagline: Sync your calendars & connect them to ChatGPT, Claude & Co.
records.description: Keep Google, Outlook, iCloud and supported CalDAV calendars in sync, one-way or two-way. Choose what gets copied: busy only, title and time, or full details. Connect the same calendars to ChatGPT and Claude to check availability, find events and create new ones. Built for people juggling work, personal and client calendars, including GMX, WEB.DE, mailbox.org and kSuite. Set it up in minutes or by simply asking your agent.

records.name: Fastlane 2.0
records.tagline: Create, launch and scale winning ads with AI
records.description: Meet Fastlane 2.0 - your next winning ad, on autopilot. What started as a simple AI organic content creation tool now runs your paid marketing end to end. Enter your website and Fastlane learns your brand, researches competitors and finds what's working. It creates high-quality AI video and image ads, runs Meta campaigns and publishes content across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. Then it studies results, doubles down on winners and uses those learnings to build smarter campaigns every time.

records.name: Mercury 3
records.tagline: The diffusion LLM that scaled 40x without slowing down
records.description: Mercury 3 is the most capable diffusion LLM released to date. It outperforms GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 while running 4–8x faster at 1,000+ tokens per second.

records.name: Kugel Ear
records.tagline: Speech-to-text that only asks when it's unsure
records.description: Speech-to-text for voice agents that only asks about the word it's unsure of. Your bot gets that word flagged, with the other spellings it heard, and asks once, like a person would, instead of making callers spell everything. €0.48 per hour.

records.name: Whiteboard
records.tagline: the open-source IDE for thoughtful software design
records.description: Whiteboard is a canvas for thoughtful software development. Critique interactive visualizations, diffs, and agent trajectories, all from one interface.

records.name: Radaric
records.tagline: AI feed reader that learns your editorial taste
records.description: Bring RSS, Telegram, X and YouTube into a feed that learns from what you approve, reject and explain. Repeating coverage of the same event goes into one story with original links. Built by a newsletter editor. From $9/mo.

records.name: Revio Product Reviews App
records.tagline: Revio – Shopify Review Management
records.description: Enhance your Shopify store with a customer-focused review experience. Revio helps merchants highlight product feedback and ratings, strengthen brand credibility, and make it easier for shoppers to discover what other customers think about their products.

records.name: CalMeter: AI Calorie Counter
records.tagline: AI calorie counter: snap your meal, know your calories
records.description: CalMeter turns a meal photo into a calorie log. Snap your plate, AI spots each food, and you confirm portions in a tap or two. Calories come from a nutrition database of 10,000+ foods, not AI guesses, so the numbers stay consistent, from dal and roti to salads and pasta. Also: food search, custom foods, weight and BMI tracking, meal reminders and a daily goal ring. Photos are never stored. Try 3 AI scans free, then go Premium for more. On iPhone and Android.

records.name: Shoptimist
records.tagline: Curated products from Amazon - handpicked by humans
records.description: Shoptimist is curated Amazon. Amazon is a great place to shop. It is not a great place to browse. Find the best products on Shoptimist.

records.name: AI Content Wizard 6
records.tagline: An AI publishing desk inside WordPress: plan, write, publish
records.description: AI Content Wizard turns WordPress into an AI publishing desk. Build a content plan from topics or keywords and let it write SEO-structured articles and longreads with images, internal links and meta for Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO or SEOPress, then publish on schedule. Content Stream rewrites RSS and public Telegram channels into original posts with their media. An SEO console in the preview fixes issues in one click. Version 6 runs on a resumable queue built for cheap shared hosting.

records.name: validateemail.io
records.tagline: email address validation service
records.description: Stop bad sign-ups, bounces and typos with a fast, developer-friendly email validation API. Try it free, no sign-up needed.

records.name: MotionGuard
records.tagline: A motion alarm for your phone when you step away
records.description: Arm MotionGuard before leaving your phone on a desk, charger or hotel nightstand, and it sounds a local alarm if the phone is moved. Free includes Normal sensitivity, a settle delay, a sensitivity test and local trigger history. Pro adds charger-removal alerts, Low/High sensitivity and best-effort Wear OS wrist alerts, as a one-time purchase or an optional 8-hour pass from a rewarded ad. No account, and no location, camera or mic permission. It alerts; it doesn't prevent theft.

records.name: Parallux
records.tagline: Free AI 3D website generation, no per-site video cost
records.description: Get a free AI 3D website builder that generates a cinematic, scroll-driven site in 15-20 seconds. Building for smaller business that want standout webdesign. Free to generate and refine, unlimited. $25/mo only once you publish. Parallux matches your brand to a library of pre-built cinematic scenes instead, so there's no per-site video cost 11 content blocks (pricing, FAQ, testimonials, stats, gallery, and more), real per-site SEO metadata, and a live editor you can refine in plain English

records.name: FleetOS
records.tagline: Fleet operations and financial visibility in one place
records.description: FleetOS connects vehicles, trips, deliveries, invoicing and financial workflows in one workspace. Request access to our private pilot.

records.name: Annonymously
records.tagline: Blocksprint AI - Crypto Recovery Tool
records.description: Explore BlockSprint AI™ crypto recovery software plans. Flexible pricing based on recovery value with 7, 30, and 90-day license options.

records.name: ngeditpdf.com
records.tagline: best pdf online tool
records.description: Kompres PDF lamaran yang ditolak portal karena terlalu besar, gabung berkas CPNS jadi 1 PDF, dan buat pas foto 3x4. Ada di HP tanpa aplikasi, tanpa watermark.

records.name: Terramapr
records.tagline: Draw on satellite maps and measure land to the foot
records.description: Terramapr lets you draw on satellite imagery and see exact measurements as you go: areas in acres or hectares, lengths in feet or metres. It’s built for fencing contractors, farmers, landscapers and property owners planning real work. Put a rate on any shape and Terramapr totals the quote, then send it to your client to accept online. Export a clean PDF plan. Free to start, no card needed.

records.name: Online Store Management OS
records.tagline: Run your whole online store from one Notion workspace
records.description: Tired of juggling spreadsheets, notes apps, and sticky notes to keep your store running? Online Store Management OS puts everything in one connected Notion. A Notion template that tracks orders, stock, profit, customers, suppliers, returns and campaigns across every sales channel. Works with Shopify, Etsy, Amazon, TikTok Shop and more. Free Notion plan is enough. Set up in 10 minutes.

records.name: Discoverify
records.tagline: The Customer Discovery Vault for Product Managers
records.description: Ask your discovery repository what customers said. Even two years ago. Discoverify turns your customer interviews into evidence for product decisions. Ask in your own words and see how many customers raised a point and since when, counted in the database, with verbatim quotes and a jump to the moment in the audio. And for German-language calls, coaching shows you afterwards how to ask better questions next time.

records.name: .par
records.tagline: More coordination. Less conflict.
records.description: PAR goes beyond shared calendars by helping separated parents coordinate family life across two households. Manage events, tasks, reminders, family information, and shared expenses in one place. Its AI assistant helps parents review pending tasks, organize activities, and anticipate what’s coming next. PAR focuses on the invisible work of co-parenting, making everyday coordination simpler and more proactive.

records.name: Mditoor
records.tagline: Write and publish MDX blogs from one desktop app
records.description: Mditoor is a free, open-source Markdown and MDX desktop editor for developers. Write blog posts, manage frontmatter and images, and publish through Git or DEV.to. Built with Tauri and Rust, with local-first editing and RTL/LTR support.

records.name: Free Text Case Converter: 13 Cases
records.tagline: UPPER, lower, camelCase, snake_case and more. Free
records.description: Most case converters stop at UPPER and lower. This one has 13 cases: lowercase, UPPERCASE, Title, Sentence, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, CONSTANT_CASE, dot.case, path/case, AlTeRnAtInG and iNVERSE. It also counts characters, words, lines and sentences, and shows reading time. It can sort lines, remove duplicates, trim spaces and strip punctuation or numbers, and has find and replace. Copy or export as TXT. Your work auto-saves in your browser. No signup.

records.name: BazaDomu
records.tagline: Multilingual property search in Czechia, Slovakia and Poland
records.description: Unlike traditional property portals, BazaDomu translates the actual listing content, not just the interface, into five languages. For faster discovery, it offers a dating-app-style swipe interface for browsing and saving properties. Users can save detailed filters as subscriptions and receive email or Telegram digests when matching listings appear. BazaDomu also extracts key property details and locations from listing text, making properties easier to filter, compare and find on the map.

records.name: Thursday Flash
records.tagline: Structured decisions, built for AI workflows.
records.description: Thursday Flash is a decision-focused AI model designed for structured classification, fixed-option scoring, verification, routing, and agent workflows. Instead of generating long-form responses, it aims to deliver concise, machine-readable outputs that software can act on. Its development prioritizes efficient inference, consistent predictions, explicit abstention under uncertainty, and policy checks that take precedence over model judgment.

records.name: MWS Website Kits
records.tagline: 390 website kits for local businesses. Pay just once.
records.description: 390 website kits for local businesses, from plumbers and bakeries to barbers and roofers. Each is a finished site you fill in with a step-by-step guide and host yourself. Pay once: $39.99 or $59.99. No monthly fees.

records.name: HLS M3U8 Debug & Demo Player
records.tagline: Play, inspect, and debug HLS streams in your browser
records.description: Test M3U8 streams with our web HLS demo player and viewer. Check native HLS playback, preview live streams, and download M3U8 video files.

records.name: Super Shortcuts
records.tagline: Context-aware automation keyboard for macOS
records.description: Hold Caps Lock and a keyboard appears: every shortcut you've bound in the app you're in, on the key it lives on. Press it, it runs. Open an app, press keys, paste a snippet, click a button, run a script: one key each. Shortcuts know which app, site or window you're in, so one key means different things in Gmail and in your CRM. Runs on your Mac, works offline, voice transcribed on-device. For most people it replaces Raycast or Alfred. Free up to 20 shortcuts; Pro $12/month.

records.name: Detect Face Shape AI
records.tagline: Free AI Face Shape Detector & 3D Biometric Try-On Suite
records.description: Detect Face Shape is a 100% private, client-side AI face analysis tool running entirely in your browser via WebAssembly. Detects 7 primary face shapes, facial symmetry, canthal tilt, and facial proportions with zero server uploads or sign-up. Completely free and natively localized across 18 languages.

records.name: SnapHome
records.tagline: Dein smartes PropTech-Betriebssystem für Immobilien.
records.description: Hybrides PropTech-ÖkoSnapHome ist das moderne All-in-One PropTech-Betriebssystem für private Eigentümer und Makler. Verwalte deine Immobilien, generiere rechtssichere Inserate und Exposés in Sekunden mit unserem KI-Assistenten Snapy, verteile Inserate auf Portale und betreue Interessenten zentral über das integrierte CRM – ganz ohne starre Fixkosten. Entwickelt für die Zukunft der Immobilienvermarktung.system mit integriertem Immobilien CRM, KI-Analysen und Multi-Channel-Distribution.

records.name: Toughened Glass Shop Fronts
records.tagline: Alpha Shop offers toughened glass shop fronts for shops.
records.description: Toughened glass shop fronts are a good choice for businesses that want a clear view of their products and a bright shop entrance. Alpha Shop offers toughened glass shop fronts for shops and commercial spaces. Toughened glass is made to be stronger than regular glass of the same thickness, making it a useful choice for many shopfront designs. It also gives your business a clean look and allows more natural light into the space.

records.name: Resend Inboxes
records.tagline: Create shared inboxes, connect your agents, build workflows
records.description: The best way to reach humans instead of spam folders. Deliver transactional and marketing emails at scale.

records.name: Reloadkart
records.tagline: Smart Tips for Gamers. Safer Gaming Voucher Purchases.
records.description: Learn what to do if your gaming voucher code has already been redeemed. Check your account, contact support, and explore possible solutions.

records.name: KAXXIS
records.tagline: Build, deploy and grow your AI-assisted SaaS apps
records.description: KAXXIS gives software creators a modular SaaS foundation for AI-assisted business apps. Build with your preferred coding assistant and the Module SDK, then package and deploy versioned modules. Reuse tenant management, accounts, permissions, branding and support instead of rebuilding them for every product. Create a customer-facing SaaS or extend an internal business platform. Developer preview by enquiry; production licensing by quotation.

records.name: RAM Optimizer
records.tagline: See what's using your RAM. Choose what can close.
records.description: RAM Optimizer is a free Windows beta that puts you in control of your memory. Analyze RAM usage, review running processes, and choose which apps are allowed to close before optimizing. Separate Analyze and Optimize buttons, Safe and Gaming modes, exclusions, and an activity history keep actions clear. Available in English and Spanish. No Python installation required. Built for transparency—not promises of higher FPS. Try it and help shape the next release.

records.name: Perennova EUDR Plot File Checker
records.tagline: Check and fix EUDR plot files before the 30 Dec deadline
records.description: Most EUDR tools are full traceability platforms. This one does one job: check the plot file before it goes into the due diligence statement. Drop a CSV, KML or GeoJSON; it is read in your browser and never uploaded. You get the errors the EU Information System would reject (open or self-intersecting polygons, swapped coordinates, over 6 decimals, points for plots above 4 ha) and a fixed GeoJSON. Free for one file; paid plans add batches and a dated report.

records.name: RoundClear AI
records.tagline: Interview answers that include how to solve it
records.description: RoundClear captures your meeting app's audio directly, so it hears your interviewer through Zoom, Teams, Google Meet or any video platform without needing a microphone. When a question lands, it generates a spoken-style answer on screen. Most interview prep stops at definitions. RoundClear goes further: where the question asks how you'd handle or fix something, the answer includes the actual steps—from first response through to resolution.

records.name: Moro - Twins & Baby Tracker
records.tagline: Newborn feeding & sleep log
records.description: Moro is a baby tracker built for newborns and twins. Log a feed, nap or diaper for every child in one tap, see them all on one 24-hour timeline, and find The Gap, when they are all asleep at once. Free to start.

records.name: SkillLens AI
records.tagline: AI-Powered Resume Analysis and Skill Gap Insights
records.description: Job hunting is challenging when you're unsure how well your skills match a role. SkillLens AI is designed to make that process clearer. It brings resume analysis, job-description matching, and skill-gap insights into a career-focused experience. Instead of relying on guesswork, job seekers can explore how their qualifications relate to job requirements and identify areas for improvement. Built for students, fresh graduates, and professionals navigating their next career move.

records.name: ABRI
records.tagline: Is the AI bubble about to burst? Track the risk.
records.description: ABRI is a daily 0–100 index measuring AI bubble risk from funding, valuations, sentiment, infrastructure spending, and market correction signals. Make your own prediction about whether—and when—the AI bubble will burst. Think you can call the top? Put your prediction to the test.

records.name: Sakhi
records.tagline: Rent, sell, learn & earn — India's village super-app
records.description: Sakhi helps people in villages and small towns earn and learn in Telugu and English. Rent Anything: rent out unused tractors, tools, tents and bikes to neighbours. Seller Corner: farmers and homemakers sell vegetables, rice, milk and pickles nearby. Plus an AI assistant, 75 free courses, an AI Test Centre, a safe ad-free Kids Mode, daily local news and rewards. My second launch after RightHire, with much more coming.

records.name: Email It In
records.tagline: Email attachments into Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Box
records.description: Email It In gives you a personal email address. Forward an email, point a scanner or copier at it, or give it to suppliers, and the attachments land in the right folder in Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Box or Egnyte. Routing rules file tagged mail into its own folder. No inbox access needed, and files are never stored on our servers. Running since 2013, with over 11 million files filed.

records.name: MindMap AI MCP
records.tagline: Build mind maps from Claude, ChatGPT or any MCP assistant
records.description: Ask Claude, ChatGPT or any AI assistant that supports MCP to build a mind map. It lands in your MindMap AI account as a real, editable map, not a text outline or a static image. Keep editing it in the same chat: expand a branch, change one node, add relationship arrows, switch layouts. Pull meetings or docs from your connected apps into one map, or map a codebase with Claude Code or Codex. No API key. Works on the Free plan with your monthly AI credits.

records.name: Bellpip
records.tagline: A bell in your Mac's notch that rings when Claude needs you
records.description: Running several Claude Code sessions? Bellpip shows each one in your MacBook notch: working, waiting, needs you, done. Pip, a little bronze bell, rings when a session needs you, with a softer chime when a long task is done, and lowers your music for the half second it plays. Click a row to jump to that exact terminal tab in Terminal, VS Code or Cursor. Native Swift, no account. Free for 7 days of use, then $9.99 once.

records.name: Forge Data Marketplace
records.tagline: Find AI datasets. Connect with data suppliers.
records.description: Forge helps AI teams explore data categories and submit sourcing briefs. Suppliers can prepare listings for review. Start with code repositories, legacy COBOL, egocentric video and more; availability and licensing are confirmed against each requirement.

records.name: Tucko
records.tagline: Your Mac’s clipboard. Saved and searchable.
records.description: Tucko turns copied text, links, images, code and colours into a searchable shelf on your Mac. Organise useful clips into pinboards, collect visual inspiration in moodboards, and reuse text with snippets. On supported Macs, Apple Intelligence can summarise, rewrite and translate copied text. Your clipboard history stays on your Mac. Native macOS app, 7-day free trial, one-time purchase.

records.name: Outdoor Kitchen Systems
records.tagline: Transform Outdoor Spaces with Modern Outdoor Kitchen Kits
records.description: Bring new possibilities to your backyard with outdoor kitchen kits from Outdoor Kitchen Systems. A well-planned outdoor kitchen can create a dedicated space for cooking, serving meals, and enjoying time with guests. Explore design ideas that complement your outdoor surroundings while supporting your entertainment needs. Whether you are refreshing an existing patio or planning a complete backyard upgrade, discover ways to create a practical and inviting outdoor cooking area that makes gatherings.

records.name: Medicolize
records.tagline: Clinic software built around the course of treatment
records.description: Medicolize is clinic management software for specialty clinics, polyclinics and groups across the Middle East, built around a course of treatment: a session package is sold once, drawn down visit by visit, and its balance is visible at every session. One patient record for every department, WhatsApp reminders, treatment quotations, billing, insurance with NPHIES and ZATCA phase 2 e-invoicing for Saudi clinics, in Arabic and English on web, iOS and Android.

records.name: DoneThat
records.tagline: Remote work's missing piece
records.description: DoneThat automatically tracks work without any manual toggles. Users are in full control and can review, delete, edit anything DoneThat creates. Don, DoneThat's work companion, proactively notifies when you dirft and helps you focus on your goals. records.name: Chalk

records.name: Hourora

Free, no account, nothing to install.

records.name: SilkStack Image Browser

records.description: Enterprise influencer marketing AI agent. You bring the brief and budget; agents source and negotiate with creators in 31 languages, grade every video against your brief and pay creators in 88 currencies. 30% fee, shown upfront. No output, no cost.

records.name: AutomIAbzh
records.tagline: AI phone reception and reservations for French restaurants
records.description: AutomIAbzh helps French restaurants handle incoming calls with an AI voice assistant. It answers common questions and manages reservations using each venue’s information and instructions, with a dedicated workspace to follow bookings and update details.

records.name: OnePager
records.tagline: One Page Resumes that get Shortlisted Under 60 Seconds
records.description: OnePager turns your CV under 60 SECONDS into a sharp one-page resume in minutes. Upload your CV, pick the role you want, and it writes a business-school style one-pager. Every bullet follows Result-Action-Context, every number comes from your own CV, and nothing is invented. It measures the real page and rewrites until everything fits on exactly one page. Download as PDF or Word. Your first one-pager is free.

records.name: Osmotic Data Filter (ODF)
records.tagline: A physical chemistry inspired python library
records.description: The first library used to handle biased numerical data without default strict decisions

records.name: Video4
records.tagline: AI Creation Studio | Image & Video Models in One Workspace
records.description: Turn Your Ideas into Cinematic AI Videos & Images

records.name: Comandu
records.tagline: Aprenda Linux e Git na prática, jogando
records.description: O Comandu é um aplicativo para aprender Linux e Git de forma prática e interativa. Aprenda comandos passo a passo, avance por uma trilha de aprendizado, pratique no terminal e acompanhe seu progresso com sequências diárias e ranking. Uma maneira mais interativa de estudar e desenvolver suas habilidades em Linux. Disponível para Android.

records.name: NockThatArchery App - Nock it. Track it.
records.tagline: Your archery training journal, connected to your coach
records.description: NockThat is a training journal for archers. Log archery, supporting exercises, and other sports—all earn XP through a Duolingo-inspired system that makes training motivating and fun. Pre- and post-training check-ins build statistics to help you understand what affects your shooting. Compete in inter-club challenges, and optionally connect with your coach through a coach-created code so they can follow your training and statistics. Built by an archery coach. Nock it. Track it.

records.name: Somatry: Cold Case Mystery
records.tagline: Solve 50 fictional cold cases. Every answer is in the file.
records.description: A story-driven cold case mystery for iPhone. Read messages, logs and interviews, flag the evidence, and name the killer, method, motive and moment. 50 cases across three fictional cities, one conspiracy. First case free. One purchase, no subscriptions, no ads.

records.name: Wishes MCP
records.tagline: Tell your AI what you love, it goes on your wishlist
records.description: Wishes MCP connects any AI client to your Wishes wishlist with one URL and OAuth. Tell ChatGPT or Claude what you love, and gift ideas land on your list with store links. Share the list, family books gifts, nobody buys twice. Free.

records.name: Greetigo
records.tagline: Birthday reminders with the message already written
records.description: Save the birthdays and anniversaries you never want to miss. The day before, Greetigo emails you a message already written. Review it, then click Send or copy it into a text. Nothing is sent without your click. New since our first launch: the home page shows your actual reminder email before you sign up, then you save it with Google, an email link, or email and password. Import from contacts, calendar or CSV files. Optional Mac app. Free for up to 10 saved dates.

records.name: Lytepic Image Compressor
records.tagline: Private browser-based image compressor to target exact size
records.description: Lytepic shrinks JPG, PNG, and WebP images right in your browser. Set custom quality or type a target size like 100 KB for online forms. 100% private — your images never leave your device.

records.name: Toolbay Flow
records.tagline: Paid AI apps rebuilt free and open source: first, dictation
records.description: A lot of paid apps are a monthly subscription wrapped around open models you could run yourself. Toolbay rebuilds them as free, open-source apps that run on your own computer, all in one free launcher for Mac and Windows. The first is Toolbay Flow: hold a key, speak, let go, and clean text appears in any app. Speech and cleanup run locally. No account needed, no word limits, no subscription. MIT licensed, and more rebuilds are on the way.

records.name: Ripitoo
records.tagline: Everyday tools for images, PDFs, QR codes & more
records.description: Ripitoo brings everyday browser-based tools into one place: compress images, work with PDFs, generate QR codes, format JSON, calculate EMI/GST, and more. No desktop installation. Built for students, creators, developers, freelancers and small businesses.

records.name: Designobo
records.tagline: Your AI chat designs real, clickable UI prototypes
records.description: Designobo is a canvas for the AI you already use. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Codex over MCP, describe a feature, and watch your agent build real, clickable screens live. Compare versions, edit by hand, comment, and share a link. Free to start.

records.name: Speaker Cleaner
records.tagline: Instantly eject water and clear dust from your speakers.
records.description: Get Speaker Cleaner is a free, browser-based utility designed to instantly restore muffled smartphone, laptop, and smartwatch audio. Unlike native tools or complex apps, it requires zero downloads or setup. Using precise frequency patterns, it rapidly vibrates and shakes loose trapped water droplets and dust particles straight from your web browser, keeping your workflow and media crystal clear.

records.name: Tavalle
records.tagline: One platform for your whole business: sales to invoicing
records.description: Tavalle replaces the CRM, the invoicing tool and the commission spreadsheet with one web app for small businesses. A lead becomes an opportunity, a quote, an order and an invoice without retyping. Sales commissions are calculated automatically, EU VAT and reverse charge are handled, and unpaid invoices carry a SEPA payment QR code. Field staff see only their own visits, and managers see revenue, costs and margins in one dashboard. In English, Spanish and French.

records.name: AgentTrust OS
records.tagline: Certify, govern and audit AI agents before they act
records.description: AgentTrust OS is the runtime trust layer for AI agents. It sits between an agent's decision and the business action that follows: certify agents before they ship, check every execution in real time (approve, retry, escalate or block in under 20 ms, no LLM needed), and keep a tamper-evident audit trail. Wrap an existing agent with one decorator. Data can stay inside your network. Built for developers shipping agents and for security and compliance teams who must prove those agents behaved.

records.name: Doxylamine B.P.+ Pyridoxine + Folic Acid
records.tagline: Doxylamine B.P. 20mg + Pyridoxine 20mg + Folic Acid 5mg
records.description: Doxytic Forte contains Doxylamine 20 mg + Pyridoxine 20 mg + Folic Acid 5 mg, prescribed to help manage nausea and vomiting during pregnancy. Ojana Pharmaceutical is a trusted PCD pharma franchise company in India, offering quality pharmaceutical products, reliable supply, competitive pricing, and professional franchise support. Use only under a qualified medical practitioner's supervision.

records.name: Generator Tracker
records.tagline: Run hours, fuel and maintenance log for your generator
records.description: Generator Tracker is a logbook for power generators. Tap Start/Stop and engine hours count themselves; enter the tank size to see fuel and runtime left, with litres per hour from your refills; set oil, filter and spark plug intervals by hours or days and see what's overdue on the home screen; monthly charts per generator. Offline-first, account optional, open source (MIT). Made in Ukraine for scheduled blackouts — useful for any backup, off-grid or job-site generator.

records.name: Accent Letters for Figma
records.tagline: 682 accented letters, one click, without leaving Figma
records.description: The mockup needs José, Müller or Łukasz, and getting that one character means leaving Figma to go and find it somewhere else. Accent Letters is a free Figma plugin. 682 accented letters in a panel, A to Z. Click one and it is added to the end of the text layer you have selected — or into a new layer if nothing is selected. Search by the letter itself, by its Unicode name, by language, or in plain words: "two dots", "squiggle", "hat". No account, no ads, no tracking.

records.name: Pricemend
records.tagline: Watches your receipts and alerts you when prices drop
records.description: Bought it, then it went on sale? Snap your receipt and Pricemend checks every item daily until the store's price adjustment window closes. When something gets cheaper, you get an alert with what the store owes you, plus a reminder before the window runs out. In the store, scan a tag to see today's online price. Works with Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic, Athleta, Best Buy, American Eagle, Hollister, Abercrombie, Staples and Costco. On the web now, iPhone app coming soon.

records.name: David Bratslavsky Uses AI to Simplify
records.tagline: David Bratslavsky leverages AI to streamline multifamily
records.description: David Bratslavsky is helping multifamily investors simplify property analysis through innovative AI automation. With QuickData.ai, he focuses on streamlining the extraction of financial information from rent rolls, operating statements, and offering memorandums. By reducing manual data entry, his approach enables analysts to prepare underwriting models more efficiently and evaluate investment opportunities with greater speed.

records.name: HelpWire
records.tagline: Remote support that starts from a link, not a setup call
records.description: Remote support software for IT teams and technicians. Send the end user a link, they run the client app and grant access, and you're in. No account or code on their side. Unattended access when you need the same machine again. Windows, macOS, and Linux.

records.name: FASTSOL
records.tagline: Real Estate Operating System
records.description: FASTSOL builds Propel-OS — real estate ERP and property management software in Pakistan. Inventory, installments and commissions in one operating system.

records.name: MyERPNetwork
records.tagline: The Professional Network Built for ERP Professionals
records.description: MyERPNetwork is a professional networking and job platform built exclusively for ERP professionals. Discover SAP and other ERP job opportunities, connect with industry experts, explore interview questions, and grow your career. Whether you're a fresher or an experienced consultant, MyERPNetwork helps you find relevant opportunities and connect with the ERP community. Join us in building a dedicated ecosystem where ERP professionals, recruiters, and career opportunities come together.

records.name: Free Baby Shower Planner, Registry &...
records.tagline: Everything you need to plan the perfect baby shower
records.description: A free baby shower planner that brings your event page, guest list, gift registry, baby predictions and guestbook together. Share one simple link with your guests — no accounts required.A free baby shower planner that brings your event page, guest list, gift registry, baby predictions and guestbook together. Share one simple link with your guests — no accounts required.

records.name: Beam-It
records.tagline: Send files straight between your devices, in the browser
records.description: Beam-It sends files, photos, messages and links straight from one device to another in the browser. Pair two devices once with a QR code or a 6-letter code, then drop files in. Works between iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows, Linux and Chromebook. Nothing to install, no account, no size limit, and files are never uploaded to a server. Also: voice and video calls, screen sharing, one-time links for people without Beam-It, and an app lock. Free.

records.name: Omnivaleur
records.tagline: List once, sell everywhere. Auto-delist when sold.
records.description: Cross-listing tool that publishes items to Marktplaats, 2dehands, Vinted, eBay, Shopify, WooCommerce and Facebook Marketplace (beta) from one dashboard, with bulk import of existing listings, automatic per-platform translation, automatic relisting, profit analytics, stale-stock repricing and a combined inbox for messages and bids.

records.name: Crypto Arbitrage Bot Development
records.tagline: Build Your Crypto Arbitrage Bot with Custom Trading Logic
records.description: Build your own Crypto Arbitrage Bot with development logic designed for real trading conditions. We develop custom crypto arbitrage software with exchange-specific order handling, trade-state reconciliation, and execution workflows that help manage differences between order placement and execution status. Our development approach aligns with your trading strategy, exchange connectivity requirements, and business objectives, helping you establish a trading built around your operational needs.

records.name: Flowy AI
records.tagline: Turn business processes into apps with AI
records.description: Describe your business process. Flowy AI generates data models, forms and workflows you can edit visually in Softyflow. Connect your existing systems, with cloud or on-premises deployment options.

records.name: Framebank
records.tagline: Reference board for filmmakers and photographers.
records.description: Save frames from the web, DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro and Lightroom into boards that sort themselves by shot type, colour, light and camera. Share projects with your crew. Free for 150 images, and your images never train AI.

records.name: Acquiry
records.tagline: Explore M&A activity by market and sector
records.description: Explore Acquiry’s M&A network through an interactive opportunity map with country drill-downs, sector views and intent filters. Records include active opportunities, historical conversations and target companies—not a list of qualified, available deals. Use the SDE/EBITDA calculator, LOI decoder and earnout modeller to explore valuation and deal structure. Calculator screenshots show illustrative inputs. Specialist acquisition and exit advisory is available separately.

records.name: PANDIT AI
records.tagline: Scan Your Palm | Get Your Palm Reading Done
records.description: Speak with the smartest AI astrologer. Get instant Vedic astrology readings by voice. Trained on millions of charts. Personal guidance 24/7.

records.name: MBX Reach
records.tagline: Email marketing and newsletters with a permanent free plan
records.description: Build your list and send newsletters with templates, a block editor, signup forms, contact tags, automations and reports. Start free with 250 contacts and 1,000 emails/month: no credit card or expiry. Paid plans start at $9/month. Available in six languages. Features and limits vary by plan. By MediaBoxEnt Technologies.

records.name: Online Free Calculator
records.tagline: you can do all calculation on calculator.company
records.description: Calculator.company website offering all types of calculators for free, you can use it to calculate all problems

records.name: TAM Global
records.tagline: Precision at molecular scale. Possibility at global scale.
records.description: TAM Global provides research-focused molecular products with clear specifications, quality documentation and evidence-focused product information.

records.name: Antarctica Trip Cost Calculator
records.tagline: Estimate the extras beyond your Antarctica cruise fare
records.description: A free planning calculator that puts cruise fare, flights, hotel buffer nights, gear, insurance, add-ons and tips in one budget. Change traveller count, cabin tier, season and extras to compare scenarios. Estimates are in USD, not live quotes or booking offers. PolarTourist is an independent affiliate-supported travel guide.

records.name: ScanMyCube
records.tagline: Yet another cube solver
records.description: Scan your Rubik's Cube with your phone or webcam and solve it step by step. Free, no app to install, and the video never leaves your device.

records.name: NexRe
records.tagline: Save links from any app. Read them later. Actually.
records.description: NexRe is a calm reading list for everything you mean to read later. Share a link from any app, and NexRe keeps it safe, picks your next read, and helps you actually finish it. Stop losing good articles in chats, tabs and bookmarks. Save once, and read when you are ready. NexRe is made for curious people who save more than they read: students, developers, researchers and anyone with a long list of "I'll read this later". Save now. Read when ready.

records.name: VerbatimIQ Analyze
records.tagline: Turn raw feedback into actionable insights.
records.description: VerbatimIQ Analyze turns thousands of open-ended responses into clear themes, sentiment and trends. Ask questions in plain English, get evidence-backed answers, and export board-ready reports — built with enterprise-grade security.

records.name: Graphite
records.tagline: Focused Markdown writing app
records.description: Graphite is a focused Markdown writing app by AROICE: Focus, Typewriter and Zen modes, Syntax Highlight and Style Check, Authorship that marks what you, AI or a source wrote, Version History, word targets, manuscripts of chapters, and export to Markdown, web pages, Word and PDF. It runs in any modern browser, installs as an app, works offline and needs no account to write. Documents stay in the browser, a folder on your disk or your own Google Drive, as plain Markdown files.

records.name: Living Projects
records.tagline: Let your AI pick up where you left off
records.description: Living Projects is a free plugin that helps your AI pick up where you left off. It saves your project’s notes, decisions, and the reasons behind them as plain-text files in your own Dropbox, Google Drive, or OneDrive. Your AI can bring that saved work together to show what’s settled, what’s open, and what comes next. In a new conversation, it can read the saved context and continue—even when you switch between Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini. Your files stay yours, in the storage you choose.

records.name: BhaiFinder — AI Memory
records.tagline: Save anything. Find it by just asking.
records.description: BhaiFinder is an AI memory app. Share any reel, link, screenshot or document from any app, and Bhai reads, tags and organises it. Months later, just ask "that Goa café reel" and it's there. New: Bhai Agent turns your saves into trip itineraries, weekly meal plans with grocery lists, and study plans. Bhai Caller phones you when a reminder is due. Pro users can search their saves from Claude and ChatGPT. Free on iOS and Android. English and Hinglish.

records.name: Isochrone.ch
records.tagline: Explore public transport accessibility in Switzerland
records.description: Isochrone.ch turns Swiss public transport timetables into an interactive travel-time map. Choose a starting point, departure time and time limit to see where you can go. Free, no signup, with fast routing directly in your browser.

records.name: Voxmint
records.tagline: Natural AI voices in 24 languages, or design your own
records.description: Text to speech with 113 natural voices in 24 languages. Hanoi and Saigon Vietnamese, Mandarin and Cantonese, Brazilian and European Portuguese. Or describe a voice in a sentence and save it; a fixed seed brings the same voice back in every project. Add [laughing] or [whispering] inline. Batch up to 100 lines, word timings for captions, and a REST API on the same credits. No voice cloning, by design.

records.name: Drift: Daily Timeline
records.tagline: Plan your day on one quiet, gesture-driven timeline
records.description: Drift is a visual daily planner for iPhone. Drag on a vertical timeline to create time blocks, hold to move or resize them, and swipe across the line to mark them done. No accounts, ads, or analytics. Your plans stay on your device, with iCloud sync when available. Free to download through October 28.

records.name: CardCloser
records.tagline: Professional profiles and marketing for real estate agents
records.description: CardCloser is the professional profile for real estate agents — one shareable place for reviews, results, listings, branding and polished marketing graphics.

records.name: SMA-Cards.com
records.tagline: New App for card collectors
records.description: SMA Cards is a collector-built, fee-free marketplace for trading and selling both TCG and sports cards. Unlike catalog-driven platforms, it uses flexible listings with condition details, location-based discovery, direct messaging and offers, making it easy to negotiate local trades or sales without rigid formats or listing fees.

records.name: How to Get Lower Mortgage Rate 10 Steps
records.tagline: How to Get a Lower Mortgage Rate: 10 Steps (2026 Guide)
records.description: Learn what affects your mortgage rate, how to compare lender offers and 10 steps that may lower your home loan cost. Includes a payment table and checklist.

records.name: LoreKeeper RPG
records.tagline: Your TTRPG world, remembered. AI worldbuilding for GMs
records.description: LoreKeeper turns your campaign notes, session recaps and sourcebooks into a living world you can talk to. Chat with your world or as your characters, generate D&D 5e NPCs with portraits and stat blocks, monsters, maps and fantasy names, and turn sessions into art, video and printable books. Moving from ChatGPT? Import your conversations as lore. Free generators need no sign-up. (Not lore-keeper.com or lorekeeper.ai; this is lorekeeper.com.)

records.name: Newmind Free AI Pre-audit
records.tagline: Is AI worth it for your business? A verdict in five minutes.
records.description: A free five-minute AI pre-audit. Get a verdict on screen, a scored report by email, and the open questions to settle before you commit a budget.

records.name: Sentify Embodied Assistant
records.tagline: Give your website an embodied assistant.
records.description: Bring your WordPress or WooCommerce website to life with an interactive 3D AI assistant. Engage visitors through natural conversations, guide them to relevant content and products, answer questions, and help them take action—all with your own AI provider and full control over your data.

records.name: Mairent
records.tagline: Rent apartments in Vietnam at local prices, no hidden fees
records.description: Finding a rental in Vietnam often means facing a 2x "expat tax", noisy broker spam, and hidden markups. Mairent connects tenants directly with verified landlords and local publishers across Da Nang and Hanoi. • 0% booking fees & no agent markups • Transparent pricing at authentic local rates • Direct chat via Telegram & email • Full trilingual listings: English, Korean, and Vietnamese Explore monthly and long-term homes on your own terms.

records.name: Focus Flow Finish
records.tagline: A calm Pomodoro timer with lo-fi music built in
records.description: Stop juggling a timer app and a music tab. Focus Flow Finish is a calm Pomodoro timer with its own lo-fi soundtrack: press start and the music starts with you, softens on your break, and a chime marks the end of each round. Pick from twelve themed spaces, each with its own sound, and keep an honest record of the hours you put in. No ads, no account, and your history stays on your phone.

records.name: Anchor SDK
records.tagline: Build the agent. Not the plumbing.
records.description: An open-source TypeScript AI agent harness with composable strategies, tools, sandbox adapters, memory, inbox delivery and traces.
